# Wayground

> Wayground (formerly Quizizz) is an AI-powered teacher platform providing standards-aligned resources, generators, and video libraries for K-12 curriculum planning and classroom instruction.

Wayground recently rebranded from Quizizz to reflect its evolution into a comprehensive AI-assisted teaching platform. The platform offers free and premium tools for creating customized educational content, managing classrooms, and accessing standards-aligned video libraries across multiple grade levels.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered tools
- Standards-aligned content
- K-12 education
- Teacher resources
- Curriculum planning
- Video library

## AI Content Generators

- [AI Lesson Plan Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/lesson-plan-generator): AI lesson plan generator for creating standards-aligned classroom lessons
- [AI Unit Plan Generator for Teachers](https://wayground.com/generators/unit-plan-generator): AI unit plan generator for creating personalized curriculum units
- [Weekly Lesson Plan Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/weekly-plan-generator): AI tool for generating customized weekly lesson plans by subject
- [Free AI Presentation Maker for Teachers](https://wayground.com/generators/ai-presentation-maker): AI presentation maker tool for creating customized classroom presentations
- [Free AI Multiple Choice Questions Generator for Teachers](https://wayground.com/generators/multiple-choice-question-generator): AI quiz generator for creating multiple choice questions across subjects
- [AI Rubric Generator for Teachers](https://wayground.com/generators/rubric-generator): AI tool for generating customizable rubrics aligned to standards
- [AI Math Problem Generator](http://wayground.com/generators/math-problem-generator): AI tool for generating customized math problems at any grade level
- [Free Worksheet Generator for Teachers](https://wayground.com/generators/worksheet-generator): AI worksheet generator for math and vocabulary sheets across grades

## Video Library

- [Maths Videos Library | Wayground](https://wayground.com/video-library/math): Math video library with standards-aligned content by grade level
- [Kindergarten Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/kindergarten-math): Kindergarten math videos covering counting, place value, and basics
- [1st Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/1st-grade-math): 1st grade math videos on addition, subtraction, and place value
- [2nd Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/2nd-grade-math): 2nd grade math curriculum videos on arithmetic and place value
- [3rd Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/3rd-grade-math): 3rd grade math videos focusing on multiplication and fundamentals
- [4th Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/4th-grade-math): 4th grade math content on fractions, decimals, geometry, and place value
- [5th Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/5th-grade-math): 5th grade math curriculum covering decimals, fractions, and standards
